Area B - SFOW (28/01).description:
Area B Sectors: 

Boulder (2B): Boulder is a feeder sector that works traffic from the south and west inbound SFO, and northwest inbound SFO CX and SJC CX airports. 

Laguna (2G): Laguna is a feeder sector that sequences traffic from the south. 

Woodside (2W): Woodside is a finals sector that works traffic to SFO landing Rwy 28L. It also works departure traffic off SQL. 

Foster (2F): Foster is a finals sector that works traffic to SFO landing Rwy 28R. 

Niles (2N): Niles is a feeder sector that works traffic from the east inbound SFO. 

Cedar (2Z): Cedar is a feeder sector that sequences traffic from the east.
